blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — Saudi authorities halted operations at Riyadh’s international airport on Saturday following a new attack that left several people wounded. The incident prompted health officials to issue an unusual mass call-up of doctors to respond to the “serious emergency,” a medical source said. Foreign embassies also urged their nationals to stay away from the airport. The Saudi civil aviation authority confirmed an attack had injured several people at the sprawling King Khalid International Airport, with a diplomatic source attributing it to a missile fired by Yemen’s Houthis.
